verdict.rationale: Vanta ships a dedicated Access Reviews product that 'automates and accelerates the access review process' with pre-built content and guided workflows. Its integrations with identity providers and productivity tools supply the connected-app user data a review would run against. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of periodic/scheduled review campaigns, in-app reviewer sign-off, the completed review artifact landing in the evidence library, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
